answer_1.quote: When fine-tuning on the EMPDIAL dataset, a response is generated given the dialogue context c... we propose a simple yet efficient technique called Affective Decoding for empathetic response generation.

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we evaluate the models in three aspects, i.e., fluency, adequacy, and diversity. Fluency is measured by perplexity, adequacy by BLEU and BOW embedding metrics, and diversity by DIST.

answer_4.quote: We conducted two forms of human evaluation: ranking for evaluating the overall performance of each system, and multi-item rating for evaluating the system performance against more fine-grained aspects... two raters (PhD students in computer science) were asked to decide which model is better... LSR results... scored on Empathy, Relevance, Fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Pairwise binary ranking (preference test) and Likert Scale Rating (LSR) with three dimensions: Empathy, Relevance, Fluency.
